ai_summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has formally announced the shareholder approval of Mr. Nikhil Goyal, a Managing Director at Blackstone Advisors India Private Limited, as a Non-Executive (Nominee) Director. This appointment materially impacts the company by bringing significant financial services and private equity expertise to the board, likely signaling Blackstone's strategic influence. No red flags are apparent, as this appears to be a standard governance update for a company with institutional investment.
